name: hrms-monorepo
description: HRMS for small businesses — Express/Prisma API and Next.js admin portal

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/backend install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f apps/backend/docker-compose.yml up -d db minio
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -f apps/backend/docker-compose.yml stop db minio
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/backend run typecheck && cd apps/web && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/backend run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
